traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Marattiaceae: large, scaly terrestrial ferns with short, stout, erect stems; fronds often very large, simple or once or more pinnate, with big fleshy stipules at the base and swollen joints along stalk and rachis; sori just inside the margin on the underside, of free or fused sporangia, without indusium.
